{{:Изучение Ложбана}}

== bau lo ponjo ==
*There is now a [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban-soudan/ Japanese Lojban Google Group].
* Various learning materials are currently being translated or developed in [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/CLL+%E5%8B%89%E5%BC%B7%E4%BC%9A+%E6%97%A5%E6%9C%AC%E8%AA%9E%E3%83%AC%E3%82%B8%E3%83%A5%E3%83%A1 Japanese].
*Japanese cmavo and gismu definitions are in [http://jbovlaste.lojban.org jbovlaste].

== bau lo polno ==
* There is now a [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban-pl/ Polish Lojban Google Group].
* Various learning materials are currently being translated or developed in [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/Mapa+Lo%C5%BCbanistanu Polish].

== bau lo fraso ==
* There is now a [http://www.lojban.org/lists/lojban-fr/ French Lojban mailing list], which you can sign up for using [http://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/lojban the mailing list web interface].
* [http://www.lojban.org/publications/brochures/brochure_french.txt French Brochure]
* There is a [http://jolapache.free.fr/lojban/index.html French website] with an exhaustive list of gismu and very nice charts of selma'o from Jonathan.

== bau lo spano ==
* There is now a [http://www.lojban.org/lists/lojban-es/ Spanish Lojban mailing list], which you can sign up for using [http://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/lojban the mailing list web interface].
* [http://www.lojban.org/publications/brochures/brochure_espanol.txt Spanish Brochure]
*Spanish cmavo and gismu definitions are in [http://jbovlaste.lojban.org jbovlaste].
* The gismu list was translated into [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/gismu_spanish.txt Spanish]

== bau lo spero ==
* [http://www.lojban.org/publications/brochures/brochure_esperanto.html Esperanto Brochure]

== bau lo dotco ==
* The gismu list was translated into [[jbocre: gi'uste bau la daitc|German]].

== bau lo xebro ==
*There is a partial [[jbocre: Hebrew gismu List|Hebrew gismu List]]

==  Other ways of contacting the community ==
* For speakers of other languages just ask on the [http://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/lojban Lojban mailing list].
* Note that [http://www.lojban.org/jbovlaste the Lojban dictionary] has translations of many languages in it.
* See also the [[jbocre: ongoing projects|ongoing projects list]] on the Wiki for some LLG-independent translation projects people are working on.
